prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Pearland, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1113; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member.
text: Driver 1 was traveling northbound and entered the intersection on a green signal when Driver 2, southbound and turning left, failed to yield and struck the driver side of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 reported pain in the lower back and difficulty turning the upper body immediately after impact. Passenger was seated in the front passenger position and was also present at the scene. Driver 2 stated that the collision occurred as Driver 1 described, and two independent witnesses gave consistent accounts of the signal phases and the point of impact. Scene photographs show intrusion damage to the driver side door and quarter panel, which is consistent with the force of a broadside collision. Responding officers observed no prior damage to either vehicle that would account for the injuries or the body damage. Passenger and both drivers were identified as occupants of the vehicles at the time of the crash. Driver 1 was identified as a resident of the policyholder's household and is listed as a covered household member. Medical transport was requested, and Driver 1 was transported to a local hospital for evaluation. Citation issued to Driver 2 for failure to yield.
